name: Capitol Debate Summer Camp at Dana Hall School
description_short: A twelve day public speaking and debate camp on the Dana Hall School campus in Wellesley for ages 10 to 17, with daily instruction, practice rounds, electives and a final day showcase. Campers can live in the dorm or commute 9 to 5; a shorter commuter Rookie Camp serves ages 8 and 9.
refund_policy_summary: Payments are nonrefundable. Written cancellation before May 1 earns full credit toward a Capitol Debate program within one year; later cancellations follow a credit timetable.
notes: Prices are full tuition. Winter early bird prices through January 31, 2027: residential $3,399, commuter $2,599, Rookie $1,999. A required $100 safety and compliance fee is added to all. Residential tuition includes room and three meals a day; commuters attend 9 to 5 on weekdays and Saturday. Registration deadline May 15. Capitol Debate's only Massachusetts camp for 2027.
